tagCitations.proposedHelp: A document scan proposes merging this passage's draft into the term. Accept merges the draft; Reject declines it.
tagCitations.driftedHelp: The cited section's text has changed since it was cited. Read it again, then confirm the citation.
tagCitations.brokenHelp: The cited section or its document is no longer in the library.
tagCitations.reviewHelp: A citation on this tag needs review: its section changed or is gone.
tagCitations.definitionReviewHelp: A section that defines this tag changed or is gone. Review its citation.
tagCitations.gapHelp: This tag requires a citation for each assignment.
tagCitations.requiresCitationDesc: An assignment of this tag with no cited library section is marked as a gap.
tagCitations.definitionDesc: The library document and section that define this tag. A citation for one assignment goes on that assignment.
